WalkSense: what the stop data looks like

One dot per 5 s window of a stop recording (Wi-Fi view: one dot per stop). Colour = place (click a legend entry to hide it, double-click to show only that place). Shape = session: circle 23 Nov, square 24 Nov session 1, triangle 24 Nov session 2, diamond 25 Nov (when present). Hover for place, session, phone and recording. Use Phone, Session and Place to look at one handset, one day or one place at a time (a place or a floor from the dropdown, or tick several places in the list below), and Colour by phone / session to see where a place's spread comes from (with one place selected the colour switches to phone; colour by session uses the shape for the phone). The variance split per place is in the kNN playground (out/knn_playground.html) and out/variance_by_place.csv. The phone is the real handset (read from each recording's metadata): Same place in different sessions landing together = a fingerprint that carries over; separate clumps per session = drift. Internal team notes, not report text.
